message.content:
Here are all form field names/labels from the image, listed in order by section:

**Location Section**
- Street Name
- House No.
- Street Code
- Neighbourhood
- Floor
- Door No.

**Rent Object Section**
- Rent Object Name
- Rent Class
- Rent Unit
- Rent Value (GHS)
- Vacant

**Contract Section**
- Start Date
- End Date
- Contract ID
- Contract Value (GHS)
- Area m²
